theorem produces {A : S.RealSpin} {a : (comparator L).RealSpin} (D : SpinRows S) (h : ∀ d, ∃ U z, Tilt P A a D d U z)
    (he : Port P a) :
    ∃ V : ∀ d, change S d, (∀ d, realH A a (V d)) ∧ Port (morph P D V) A := by
  choose U z hv using h
  choose V hw hz using fun d => meet P _ (hv d)
  refine ⟨V,hw,fun_prop_rest V hw hz⟩
where
 fun_prop_rest (V : ∀ d, change S d) (hp : ∀ d, realH A a (V d)) (ht : ∀ d k x, D d k (V d x)=V d (P.lie d k x)) :
    Port (morph P D V) A := {
    spin := fun d x => (V d).toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp (he.spin d ((V d).symm x))
    fixes := fun d x => by simp [morph,he.fixes]
    sends := fun d v x p => by simp [morph,he.sends]
    signed := fun d v x => by
      simp only [morph,LinearEquiv.trans_apply,he.signed,(hp d).1, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    real := fun d s x => by
      obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := (V d).surjective x
      simp only [morph,LinearEquiv.trans_apply,← (hp d).2, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,he.real]
    spinAt := fun d g x => by
      obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := (V d).surjective x
      let L := (V d).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ
      simp only [morph,LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,ht]
      exact L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 (he.spinAt d g u) }

proof_context.conclusion: `produces` proves `Port (morph P D V) A`: the transported action is continuous, real, extends the signed action and has generator `D`.

private theorem cov_parameter (H : S.Hierarchy) (V : DiffPlan S) (hd : V.Derivatives S)
    (U : Rotation S) (hU : Spin.Port U H.spin)
    (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Points n), x ∈ conf n → Still V U.lie x)
    (K : Ortho.Skew) (t : ℝ) : Cov U (Ortho.oneParameter K t) := by
  intro n v x hx
  let f := fun s => S.useAt S (Points.move (Ortho.oneParameter K s) x) (U.label (Ortho.oneParameter K s) ∘ v)
  have he (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt f 0 s := by
    have hh : HasDerivAt f (angular V U.lie (U.label (Ortho.oneParameter K s) ∘ v) K
        (Points.move (Ortho.oneParameter K s) x)) s := parameterDeriv H V hd U hU K x hx v s
    rwa [hs n _ (Points.move_in _ hx) _ K] at hh
  have hc : f t = f 0 := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
    (fun s => (he s).differentiableAt) (fun s => (he s).deriv) t 0
  change f t = _
  rw [hc]
  unfold f
  rw [parameter_zero]
  exact cov_one hU n v x hx

proof_context.conclusion: `cov_parameter` shows covariance under one-parameter rotations from `Still V U.lie` (the angular identity makes the correlator constant along the flow, `parameterDeriv`).

private theorem oriented (hg : YM.Bid.A13) (H : S.Hierarchy) (V : DiffPlan S) (hd : V.Derivatives S)
    (U : Rotation S) (hU : Spin.Port U H.spin) (hs : ∀ n (x : Points n), x ∈ conf n → Still V U.lie x) :
    U.Oriented S := by
  let A : Subgroup Ortho := {
    carrier := {s | Cov U s}
    one_mem' := cov_one hU
    mul_mem' := cov_mul hU
    inv_mem' := cov_inv hU }
  have hi : YM.Bid.AxisGens ≤ A := by
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le A).mpr
    rintro x (⟨s,rfl⟩ | ⟨K,t,rfl⟩)
    · exact cov_signed H U hU s
    exact cov_parameter H V hd U hU hs K t
  rw [show YM.Bid.AxisGens = ⊤ from hg] at hi
  intro n v x hx K
  exact (show Cov U K from hi (Subgroup.mem_top K)) n v x hx

proof_context.conclusion: `oriented` shows covariance under all of `O(4)` since signed permutations and one-parameter rotations generate it (`A13`).

theorem laws_of_oriented (H : S.Hierarchy) (V : DiffPlan S) (hi : V.Inclusions S)
    (hd : V.Derivatives S) (U : Rotation S) (hU : Spin.Port U H.spin)
    (ho : U.Oriented S) : U.Laws V H.spin := by
  exact {
    spin := hU.spin
    fixes := hU.fixes
    group := hU.sends
    signed := hU.signed
    real := hU.real
    identity := unit_fixed H U hU ho
    filtered := fun _ _ w s v => Spin.team U H hU ho V hi w s v
    vector := vectorLaw H V hd U hU ho
    infinitesimal := hU.spinAt }

proof_context.conclusion: `laws_of_oriented` derives the unit, inclusion and vector laws from covariance by testing against exterior words.

lemma Commission.picks (Z : Commission V W I H) (hv : V.Inclusions S) (hp : V.Derivatives S) :
    ∃ c U J, Tab S V W I H c U J ∧ ∃ K0 : Boundary.Spins S, K0.Descends (mill W I c U) H.basis.kernel.spin := by
  obtain ⟨c,Hc⟩ := Z.scales hv hp (Z.shape hv hp)
  obtain ⟨U,hu,ht,hp'⟩ := Climb.descends W.T W.lit _ V Hc hp (Z.lens hv hp c Hc)
  obtain ⟨he,hh⟩ := Z.group c U hv hp ht hp'
  obtain ⟨J,h1,h2,h3⟩ := Z.retune c U hv hp Hc he hh
  have hj : Tab S V W I H c U J := ⟨Hc,hu,ht, hv,hp,H.aligned,he,hh, Climb.comparison H.weak,h1,h2,h3⟩
  refine ⟨c,U,J,hj,Spin.reach V W.T U (c⁻¹ • I.Y) hu ?_ hv H.basis.kernel.laws.toSymmetric W.vacuum W.rolls (Z.generate c U J hj)⟩
  exact Spin.transmits U _ W.lit _ ht

proof_context.conclusion: `picks` assembles `c`, the frames `U` and the rotation `mill W I c U` with generator `c⁻¹ Y` and the same `c` in every degree.
